learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn how Adjectives (Describing Words) make sentences interesting by telling us about color, shape, size, and number.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 I saw a monster today! 👾 Was it a scary monster or a cute monster? Was it a green monster or a pink monster? We need Describing Words to know the truth!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Words that describe or tell us more about Naming Words (Nouns) are called Adjectives (विशेषण). They add color and fun to our sentences!
Every color word and shape word in the dictionary is an Adjective! They tell us exactly what something looks like.
Words that tell us how big, small, heavy, or light a noun is are also Adjectives.

lesson_modules.module_title: 🔢 Numbers are Adjectives Too! (संख्या भी विशेषण है)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: Did you know that numbers describe nouns too? They tell us 'how many' things there are.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Choose the Adjective from this phrase: 'A cold drink'.
❓ Which word describes an ice cream best?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank with a color adjective: 'The sky is _____.'
subjective_practice.hint: What color do you see when you look up during the day?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Circle the adjective in this sentence: 'I have three pencils.'
subjective_practice.hint: Remember, numbers are also describing words!

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Think of your favorite animal. Write one adjective to describe it.
subjective_practice.hint: Is your animal big, furry, fast, or loud?

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎨 The Mystery Bag
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Put an object inside a bag. Ask your mom or dad to put their hand inside without looking. Ask them to use three Adjectives (like soft, round, smooth) to guess what it is!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Adjectives are Describing Words that tell us more about Nouns.
⭐ They describe color, shape, size, feel, and taste.
⭐ Number words (one, two, three) are also Adjectives.
